title: Accordion Hubstream: simplify workspace switching and lateral sidebar routing
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: The current console has multiple overlapping navigation affordances (left rail, command palette, hub cards) that confuse new users and surface duplicate paths to dashboards, rollouts, and cost lenses. Users report twice as many clicks to reach common routes (dashboards, rollouts, workspace-specific cost views) and frequent misrouted context when switching workspaces. Goal: Propose a compact "Accordion Hubstream" pattern that compresses workspace switcher, pinned routes, and contextual routes into an adaptive lateral rail. The pattern should reduce cognitive overhead, preserve fast keyboard navigation, support role-aware pins, and make cost/rollout dashboards one tap away on workspace switch. This ticket captures ideation, prototypes, review feedback, and handoff-ready assets.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates single-tap workspace switch that retains last-opened dashboard per workspace
Left-rail collapses to icon-only with an accordion showing pinned routes on hover or keyboard focus
Keyboard nav (Cmd/Ctrl+K) shows prioritized workspace results and pinned routes first
Design tokens and spacing follow console design system; no new global tokens required
PM/Eng signoff obtained on route naming and analytics hooks for A/B rollout
Usability test (5 users) shows median task completion time reduced by >=25% for 'open cost dashboard in other workspace'

comments: 2025-01-12 Ava Martinez: Initial ticket created after IA sync. Attached rough sketches and list of problematic flows from support triage.

2025-01-20 Maya Chen (PM): Suggested keeping 'Billing / Cost' as a top-level pinned route for enterprise workspaces; requested analytics event for 'workspace_pin_click'.
2025-01-23 Eng spike update (ENG-2345): Feasibility okay for icon-only rail with hover accordion; need to limit DOM elements to avoid reflow on large orgs. Suggest lazy render of pinned route lists.

2025-01-28 Usability research (Noah): Prototype test with 5 participants. Key finding: users expected workspace switch to preserve last open dashboard. Two users attempted to use the command palette rather than the new rail—need clearer affordance for switching.
2025-02-01 Design review: PM + Eng feedback incorporated. Added 'sticky last-dashboard' behavior and explicit shortcut hint in the hover state. Preparing hi-fi for review.
2025-02-04 Ravi Kapoor: Hi-fi delivered and exported. Includes micro-interactions and edge-case flows (workspace with 0 dashboards, role-restricted pins). Ready for design QA.
2025-02-05 Ava Martinez: Updated acceptance criteria with usability target and added release tag console-2025.03. Marked In Review and requested stakeholder signoff by 2025-02-12.
review_feedback: Maya Chen (PM): +1 for reducing clicks. Please ensure 'cost dashboard' naming aligns with billing product. Add analytics event 'switcher_cost_opened'.
ENG-2345: Concern about render performance for orgs with 100+ pinned routes. Recommend server-suggested top-8 pins and client-side 'more' overflow.
Security (Priya Singh): Confirmed no new network surface; ensure audit log events for workspace switch to meet compliance.
decision_log: 2025-01-18: Decided to use icon-only compact rail collapsed by default to maximize canvas width based on product meetings.
2025-01-25: Decided on 'sticky last-dashboard' per workspace (persisted in user settings) to reduce context loss.
2025-01-30: Agreed to implement server-side prioritization of pinned routes and client-side lazy render to balance performance and UX.
risks: Users may not discover expanded pinned routes in icon-only mode — mitigation: add discoverability microcopy and keyboard hint
Large orgs could still have many pinned routes leading to overflow complexity — mitigation: enforce top-8 with 'more' menu and plan for server-side ranking
Analytics gaps if events are missed during rollout — mitigation: include automated event smoke tests in release pipeline
